verdicts.quote: It's been two years since I have last seen him.
verdicts.reason: This is not the normal American English pattern; use past simple after since here: “since I last saw him.”

verdicts.quote: I am living here since I was ten.
verdicts.reason: The correction is also nonstandard for a situation continuing to the present; it should use the present perfect, such as “I have lived here since I was ten.”

verdicts.quote: correct": "I am living here since I was ten."
verdicts.reason: This contradicts the sense-one explanation and adaptation note, both of which correctly say that this continuing-time use normally takes the present perfect.

verdicts.quote: It's been two years since I have last seen him.
verdicts.reason: The example fits the time sense but is not natural standard American English because “have last seen” should be “last saw.”
